name: interweave
description: Canton and EVM institutional interoperability control plane

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @interweave/core && npm run build --workspace @interweave/sdk && npm run build --workspace @interweave/cli && npm run build --workspace @interweave/examples
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @interweave/core && npm run check --workspace @interweave/sdk && npm run check --workspace @interweave/cli && npm run check --workspace @interweave/examples && npm run python:check && npm run contracts:check && npm run daml:check && npm run local:check
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @interweave/core && npm run test --workspace @interweave/sdk && npm run test --workspace @interweave/cli && npm run test --workspace @interweave/examples && npm run python:test && npm run contracts:test && npm run daml:test
scripts.test:security-invariants: npm run build --workspace @interweave/core && node --test packages/core/dist/security-invariants.property.test.js && npm run contracts:test
